claims.text: CALL EDI sites are float-to-double writes with TEST EAX,0x207 error checks (serializer pattern, structural); EDI and the frame are bound before 0085C780, entry not in evidence.
EBX carries an outer saved object: float fields +0x20..+0x2C, pointer +0x30, pointer array +0x50/+0x54 (children) iterated with virtual slot+0x8 boolean per element; EBX identity/class UNKNOWN.

Provider read path: if [ESI+0x2C]!=null and [ESI+0x20]==3, slots +0xAC (float) and +0xB0 (3-float out) are dispatched on the provider; else the 0085CD06 factory path creates it. Both in the same body as the 0085CD17 store.
